title: Actual cuTile vs CUDA PyTorch SDPA

environment.baseline_note: Existing unfused FP32 CuPy baseline is retained in the project benchmark. This experiment adds vendor/framework SDPA and directly compares it with the fused cuTile kernel using identical GPU-resident FP16 Q/K/V.
